Loss report: gitlab -> gha
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci job.if: !github.event.deleted on every job (GitHub Actions runs a push workflow when a branch is deleted and the source starts no run for that; each job condition ends with the guard)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/test job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/test step.action: actions/checkout step (GitLab clones the repository before every job and GHA does not; GIT_DEPTH and GIT_SUBMODULE_STRATEGY map to the step inputs)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/test/step/script step.shell: bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it, and a runner such as act runs a step with no shell under sh; the script re-executes under bash when the image has bash, else under sh -e)
